module_catalog.name: Research principles 701
module_catalog.content: Concepts of research; Research process; research studies appraisal; planning and developing literature review; developing research idea and research question; research principles in designing proposal; research proposal writing.
module_catalog.prerequisites: RHC 480, or RCH 300 and RCH 400 or equivalent.
module_catalog.contact_time: 1 discussion class per week, 1 lecture per week

module_catalog.name: Foundation of diagnostic ultrasound 710
module_catalog.content: Ultrasonography physics: • Fundamentals of piezoelectricity. • Instrumentation. • Biological effects and safety of ultrasonography Imaging methods. • Ultrasonography artefacts. • Imaging methods. Ultrasonography equipment operation: • frequency (choice varies depending on average wave penetration, attenuation, scattering, etc.), • scan format and probe type (choice depends on the size of the scanned anatomical plane and the possibility of access via acoustic "windows"); Scanner controls: • Ultrasonography power output; • overall receiver gain, swept gain (e.g., time gain compensation); • focal length; • display controls; • brightness; • contrast; • image selection and storage (freeze-frame); Image-record features: • patient identification; • indication of distance scale (use of callipers); • calculations of gestational age from bi-parietal diameter; • cross-sectional areas, etc.; • image-recording capabilities (e.g., self-processing or not, single or multi format). Physics: • Advanced level theory of Doppler methods. • Contrast agents. • Biological effects of Doppler. • Endo-probes. • Interventional technique equipment. Equipment: • Real-time scanner. • Continuous wave Doppler. • Pulsed wave Doppler. • Colour flow imaging. • Power imaging. • Foundations of Ultrasound. • General principles of scanning and image evaluation. • Quality management and problem solving. • Medico-legal aspects and radiobiology in ultrasound. • Reflective practitioner in ultrasound. • Professional role within the community and responsibilities to the community.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Physics and introduction to ultrasound on undergraduate level.

module_catalog.name: Abdominal ultrasound 711
module_catalog.content: Anatomic, Pathological and Physiological relationships within the abdominal cavity. Abdominal scanning techniques and protocols. Patient care in ultrasound. Image evaluation and pattern recognition. Report writing. Problem-solving. Examinations of the vascular system, liver, gallbladder and the biliary system, pancreas, urinary system, retro-peritoneum, peritoneal cavity and abdominal wall, pelvis. Abdominal ultrasound application of ultrasound contrast agents. Ultrasound-guided interventional techniques. Inter-professional management within trauma, surgical theatre and hospital wards. Infection control. Medical equipment – IV’s, suction, catheters, chest and drainage pumps, other equipment. Psycho-social management of the patient examined. Execution of Ultrasonography examinations and procedures. Image evaluation and pattern recognition. Report writing. Problem-solving. New advances in ultrasound.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Fundamentals of ultrasound and Cross-sectional anatomy on undergraduate level.

module_catalog.name: Superficial structures in ultrasound 712
module_catalog.content: Anatomic, pathological and physiological relationships. Scanning techniques and protocols. Patient care in ultrasound. Image evaluation and pattern recognition. Report writing. Problem-solving. Examinations of the breast, thyroid and parathyroid glands, scrotum and musculoskeletal system. Ultrasound-guided interventional techniques. Execution of ultrasonography examinations and procedures. Image evaluation and pattern recognition. Report writing. Problem-solving. New advances in abdominal ultrasound.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Fundamentals of ultrasound and Cross-sectional anatomy on undergraduate level.

module_catalog.name: Gynaecology and obstetrics ultrasound 713
module_catalog.content: Normal anatomy and physiology of the female pelvis. Pathology of the uterus, ovaries and adnexa. Sonographic and Doppler evaluation of the female pelvis. The role of ultrasound in evaluating female infertility. The role of ultrasound in obstetrics. Clinical ethics and patient care for obstetric ultrasound. Normal and abnormal ultrasound in the first trimester. Execution of Ultrasonography examinations and procedures. Image evaluation and pattern recognition. Report writing. Problem-solving. New advances in obstetric ultrasound (3D and 4D).

module_catalog.name: Cardiovascular ultrasound 714
module_catalog.content: Anatomic, pathological and physiological relationships within the thoracic cavity. Echocardiography evaluation and technique. Extra and intra cerebrovascular evaluation, technique and patient care. Peripheral arterial and venous evaluation. Doppler ultrasonography and analysis. Execution of ultrasonography examinations and procedures. Image evaluation and pattern recognition. Report writing. Problem-solving.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Fundamentals of ultrasound and vascular anatomy on undergraduate level.

module_catalog.name: Paediatric ultrasound 715
module_catalog.content: Neonatal echoencephalography. Paediatric abdomen. Neonatal hips and spine. Patient care. Execution of ultrasonography examinations and procedures. Image evaluation and pattern recognition. Report writing. Problem-solving.

module_catalog.name: Musculoskeletal ultrasound 716
module_catalog.content: Anatomic, Pathological and Physiological relationships. Scanning techniques and protocols. Patient care in ultrasound. Image evaluation and pattern recognition. Report writing. Problem-solving. Examinations of the musculoskeletal system. Ultrasound-guided interventional techniques. Execution of ultrasonography examinations and procedures. Image evaluation and pattern recognition. Report writing. Problem-solving.
